ruling.explanation:
Trip TRP-02825: the booked optimal route was 14.0 km, and the platform's GPS trace measures the trip at 18.2 km (the trip record's convenience copy agrees). The excess is 4.2 km, which is 30.0% of the optimal distance — above both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs; here it and the trip-record copy coincide at 18.2 km, so the finding does not turn on which field is read. The trace is not MATERIAL (4.2 km is under 8.0 km and 30.0% is under 50%).

IMPAIRMENT DISCLOSURE (POL-GEN-02(3)): EV-GPS-02825 carries a schema-level impairment at weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a single 40.0-second sampling gap from 14:00:32 to 14:01:12, 0.4 km apart. Two things must both be said: the artifact is impaired at the admissibility layer, AND it is clean for policy purposes. Under POL-RD-07(a)–(c) the gap is under 90 seconds, the jump is under 500 m, and the sampling interval is 10 seconds, so POL-RD-07's consequences are not triggered and the deviation may be measured on the trace. The 0.85 weight discounts how firmly the ruling can be pressed and caps my confidence at 0.85; the finding survives the discount, because the gap sits in a stretch that bears on none of the 4.2 km of excess.

NO EXCULPATORY CLAUSE APPLIES. The driver's statement 'Navigation rerouted me' asserts an external traffic cause but names no advisory and cites no evidence ID. The only advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02825-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0 with no payload, so the comparison POL-RD-03 requires cannot be run: POL-RD-03 is unavailable and, under POL-RD-08, the assertion carries no weight. POL-RD-13(1) confirms this is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation — an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one — and because the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c), POL-RD-13(2) sets the deviation at the measured figure with POL-RD-02 running against the booked optimal route. The chat log is empty (0 messages), so POL-RD-04 exonerates nothing and POL-RD-14 is not reached; pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not displace the 14.0 km baseline.

NO REPEAT-DEVIATION UPLIFT OR REFERRAL. The driver's profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 1 against completed_trips_90d of 162 — a ratio of 0.006 — below both POL-RD-06 pattern limbs, so no pattern is established, no FULL_REFUND uplift follows, and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is produced. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used.

REMITTANCE (POL-RD-02, METERED fare): recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 14.0 km + 0.28 × 19.0 min) × 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 surcharges + 0.00 waiting fee − 0.00 promo = 19.62 + 0.80 = 20.42. The surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, the only artifact that carries it. Refund = charged_total 26.73 − recomputed_fare 20.42 = 6.31, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and 23.6% of the charged total — far below the 90% share that would make it a FULL_REFUND. Rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, the refund is SGD 6.35. The fare breakdown carries no ERP or toll lines and no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and nothing is double-counted. No driver compensation is due: the rider was billed for the full 18.2 km the trace records, so POL-RD-04's unbilled-distance limb has no shortfall to work on.

The rider's burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02825 with matching times, and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0, so no extra corroboration beyond the trace is required. The outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.35 to the rider; the monetary effect is at or below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it executes on issue. Confidence is 0.85, above the 0.70 floor, so the case does not escalate.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
